title: South Korea Regional Wage Data (sido level, industry-based, no occupation dimension)

admin_code.description: SGIS sido code. 'KR-NAT' for the national total (사업체노동력조사 national estimate, NOT a weighted average of the 17 sido values), else the 2-digit SGIS sido code 11-39 (00 in the source table maps to KR-NAT here for consistency with other country modules).

admin_level.description: 0 = national (사업체노동력조사 national estimate). 1 = sido (17 first-tier administrative units per SGIS). This module has no admin_level 2/3 -- no wage data of any kind is published at 시군구 level (see README section on what's not available).

wage_value.description: Value in units given by 'currency' and 'wage_period'. Populated from 월급여액 (monthly pay = 정액급여 + 초과급여, excludes 특별급여) unless wage_measure states otherwise. Leave null + data_availability='not_available' rather than estimating.

currency.description: All figures in this table are published in 천원 (thousand KRW) per the MOEL release.

wage_measure.description: Which of the five parallel MOEL series this row reports. wage_total (임금총액) = monthly_pay + special_pay. monthly_pay (월급여액) = regular_pay + overtime_pay, EXCLUDES special_pay. These five series are components of one another, not independent alternatives -- never average across wage_measure values.

data_availability.description: Finest level at which this row's figure is genuinely published. This table structurally stops at sido -- no 시군구 (city/county/district) wage figure exists in any published Korean official statistic (see README).
